title: Kenya Fly-In Mara + Laikipia & Rift Lakes Camping Loop, Dec 26 2026 – Jan 11 2027
overview:
- **Dates:** LAX Sat Dec 26 → LAX Mon Jan 11. 16 nights: **12 Kenya**, 2 Istanbul (free TK stopover), 2 on planes.
- **Route:** fly to Nairobi → Karen 1n rest → fly to Mara (Enonkishu, Ngerende strip) 3n, NYE in camp → fly to Nanyuki → Ol Pejeta 2n → Nakuru 2n → Naivasha 2n → JKIA-area hotel 2n → IST 2n → home.
- **Parks (5):** Mara conservancy, Ol Pejeta, Lake Nakuru, Lake Naivasha, Hell's Gate.
- **Budget: ~$6,574 pp point est; realistic $6,400–6,900** (festive crew pricing). ≤$6,500 only if KATO quotes land at $145–165/day. 5% contingency held until 3 written quotes.
- **≤$6k path (lead option):** drop Naivasha + $145 flat quote → ~$5,984, 4 parks, no day over 5h. Alt: drop Nakuru ~$5,989 (one 4.5–5h day, at the cap).
- **Fatigue:** longest road day 4–5h (Jan 3), zero day each side. Jan 1 post-NYE flight day honestly 3–4.5h. 8 zero-travel days. Airport-area hotel = no 01:30 pickup.
- Ol Pejeta ≠ Mara: rhinos/chimps in Laikipia vs big cats on the plains.

itinerary.title: Fly toward Nairobi
itinerary.details: Christmas at home. TK10 LAX 19:45 → IST 19:00 next day (~13h). Sleep on Kenya time (UTC+3).

itinerary.title: Connect at IST
itinerary.details: Land 19:00. ~1.5h airside connect (real but tight). TK607 20:30 → NBO 03:05. Missed? See Practical: fallback = Mara 1 night shorter.

itinerary.title: Land + full rest day
itinerary.details: Land 03:05. ~45m to Karen B&B (room held from Dec 27). Sleep to ~11:00. Zero travel. Daylight, no naps after 15:00.

itinerary.title: Fly to the Mara (afternoon)
itinerary.details: Slow morning. 20m to Wilson ~12:30. Afternoon flight to Ngerende strip (~45m–1h, stops possible). 15–30m to camp. ~2–2.75h door to door. Short dusk drive.
itinerary.meals: B own; L light; D camp

itinerary.title: Full Mara day
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Dawn + late-pm drives, off-road, few vehicles. Midday siesta. Big cats, plains game.

itinerary.title: Walk, drive, NYE in camp
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Maasai walk am, drive pm. Quiet NYE by the fire; bed by ~22:00 is fine. Pack 15 kg bag tonight.

itinerary.title: Fly Ngerende → Nanyuki
itinerary.details: Late start. 15–30m to strip, 30m check-in. Latest sector, direct if it runs (1h10; ~2h with stops). 45m to OPC camp. ~3–4.5h door to door. Rest pm.

itinerary.title: Rhinos + chimps
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Black/white rhino, Sweetwaters chimps, Morani, Mt Kenya views. Optional lion tracking (~$70). Early night.

itinerary.title: Long road day to Nakuru
itinerary.details: 4–5h door to door via Nanyuki, Nyahururu. 30–45m Thomson's Falls stop. No transit drive: gate ~14:00, 15–20m to camp inside. Rest.
itinerary.overnight: KWS public campsite inside Lake Nakuru NP

itinerary.title: Nakuru day
itinerary.details: Zero transfer. Dawn drive to Baboon Cliff, flamingos/pelicans, rhino, Rothschild giraffe. Siesta in camp. Short late drive optional.
itinerary.overnight: KWS public campsite inside Lake Nakuru NP

itinerary.title: Short hop to Naivasha
itinerary.details: Short drive on the way out (ticket runs to ~14:00). 1.5–2h via Gilgil. Lakeshore camp by lunch. Hippos at dusk.

itinerary.title: Hell's Gate + boat
itinerary.details: Zero transfer (30m local). Bike or walk Hell's Gate early. Boat + Crescent Island walk pm, optional. Rest.

itinerary.title: Road to airport-area hotel
itinerary.details: 2.5–3h via A104 Limuru + Southern Bypass (Mai Mahiu only if open). Check in by lunch. Shower, laundry. Crew farewell.

itinerary.title: Buffer day
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Pool, repack. Optional Sheldrick 11:00 (~40m, +$15). Early dinner, bed ~19:30. No 01:30 pickup: hotel is 10–20m from JKIA.

itinerary.title: Early flight to Istanbul
itinerary.details: Wake ~02:45, shuttle 03:00, 10–20m. TK608 04:50 → IST 11:45 (~7h). Free TK Stopover hotel. Nap; easy evening.

itinerary.title: Easy Istanbul day = real pre-long-haul buffer
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Hagia Sophia, Cistern, Bosphorus ferry (Grand Bazaar shut Sun). Pack. Early night.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.details: Relaxed morning. TK9 IST ~14:30 → LAX ~18:15 same day (~13h45). Stay up till ~21:00 LA time.

practical:
## Entry
- Kenya eTA $30, **etas.gov.ke only**. Türkiye transit/stopover visa-free. Passport 6+ mo, 2 blank pages.

## Flights
- TK10 19:45→19:00+1 (from Oct 24, 2026). TK607 **20:30 → 03:05**. 1.5h connect: real, tight.
- **Missed connect fallback:** TK rebooks next night → land **03:05 Dec 29**. Sleep at Karen (room already held). Move Mara flight to **Dec 30** (changeable fare). Mara drops to 2n; NYE still in camp. Karen room +1 night (~$60 pp).
- Free TK Stopover: **once per ticket**, not N/R fares. Used on return.
- Bush flights **15 kg pp**, soft bags. Mara strip = **Ngerende** (Safarilink/AirKenya, ~2×/day), ~15m to Enonkishu.

## Jet lag (+11h)
- Shift sleep 1–2h earlier the week before. Sleep on Kenya time on board.
- Dec 28 full rest. Dec 29 afternoon flight = lazy morning. Dec 30–31 zero travel.

## Road reality
- Nakuru→OPC leg (Jan 3) **4–5h door to door**. Falls stop ≤45m.
- Mara fly-in both ways. Mulot road never used.
- Naivasha→JKIA area 2.5–3h via A104/Southern Bypass.
- Jan 1: **3–4.5h** door to door after NYE. Want it easier? +1 Mara night (+$300).

## Fees
- KWS court case: only **Hell's Gate + Nakuru** (new $50/$90 vs old $26/$60).
- Nakuru 2×24h, single entry; camp inside.
- OPC + Mara conservancies not KWS. Cashless.

## Operator must confirm in writing
- Enonkishu mobile camping allowed + fee + strip→camp time. Else Pardamat/Ol Chorro.
- Per-day rate incl. festive uplift. Repositioning in/out.

## Health (CDC)
- Yellow fever recommended outside Nairobi. Malaria pills from Dec 27 to 7 days after. DEET.

## Camping
- Walk-in tents, beds, bucket shower, toilet tent. Askari at night. Laikipia/Nakuru nights ~8–12°C: fleece.

## Money/safety
- ~130 KES/$. Crisp USD for tips. Kenya Level 2: Uber/Bolt, no night walks. Plastic bags banned.

- Dec 27 Sun | 1.5h connect + 6.5h | long-haul pt 2 (one journey)
- Dec 28 Mon | 45m at 04:00, then 0 | ZERO

- Jan 2 Sat | 0 | ZERO
- Jan 3 Sun | 4–5h road | long
- Jan 4 Mon | 0 | ZERO

- Jan 7 Thu | 2.5–3h | light

Rules:
- **Max ~5h road, prefer ≤4h:** met. Only Jan 3 >4h (4–5h incl. ≤45m falls stop); zero day each side.
- **No back-to-back ≥3.5h:** met. Jan 1 (up to 4.5h) and Jan 3 split by zero Jan 2. Two near-long days in 3; fix = +1 Mara night (+$300).
- **Min 2 nights/stop, ≤1 transit night:** met. Only Karen Dec 28 is 1n.
- **Light arrival:** met. Overnight Nairobi, full rest day, afternoon Mara flight.
- **Zero day per ~4 days:** 8 (Dec 28, 30, 31, Jan 2, 4, 6, 8, 10).
- **Buffer before long-haul home:** Jan 8 at airport-area hotel (no 01:30 pickup; 02:45 wake, 10–20m). Real buffer = Jan 10 IST before TK9.
- **Jet lag:** +11h, no IST reset. Rest day + 2 zero Mara days. IST reset +$235.
- **Removed:** Mara→Wilson reversed loop (Jan 1 5–5.5h = breach).
- **Return ≤ Jan 16:** Jan 11 (+Mara night Jan 12; Samburu Jan 13).
